description.ja: 大好きなヒーローをキミの手でつくろう！全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に、ドラえもんが登場！
description.en: Create your favorite hero with your own hands! Doraemon appears in the introductory series "ENTRY GRADE" for all those who have no experience with plastic models!

description.ja: • タッチゲートだからパーツは手で“プチッ！”と取れる！
description.en: • Because it is a touch gate, parts can be removed by hand!

description.ja: • 少ないパーツ数（13パーツ）で、プラモデルを初めてつくる方でもサクサクと組み立てが可能！
description.en: • With a small number of parts (13 parts), even those who are making plastic models for the first time can easily assemble it!

description.ja: • 各部位の色分けはパーツにより再現！
description.en: • Color coding of each part is reproduced by parts!

description.ja: • 接着剤や工具は不要。説明書は見やすい色付き。
description.en: • No glue or tools required. The manual is colored for easy viewing.
